detail.exclusions_considered: Routine quality testing, compliance inspections and post-commercial-production adaptation excluded from qualified time

four_part_test.elimination_of_uncertainty: Whether residual acid heel can be recovered to the transfer line without manual car entry, and which sequence of nitrogen-assisted push, drain angle and containment-sump return achieves it within the 72-hour free time
four_part_test.process_of_experimentation: Instrumented trials of four transfer sequences on shipper cars, measuring residual heel by weight and sump return; failed sequences recorded and abandoned

detail.name: Acid tank-car heel recovery and containment-drain transfer process
